paras: Application: Toyota GR Supra A90 / A91 and BMW Z4 G29 with 2nd generation B58TU engine and Radium 20-0753 Port Injection Kit Part Type: Port injection fuel rail plumbing kit Part Number: 20-0753-PK

The Radium 20-0753-PK Fuel Rail Plumbing Kit connects the OEM low-pressure fuel feed hose to the rear of the Radium 20-0753 port injection fuel rail, so the added port injectors are supplied straight from the factory low-pressure fuel system.
hl: OEM Feed Connection: SAE quick connect tee PTFE hose assembly taps into the factory low-pressure fuel feed
Preassembled Hose: 6AN PTFE fuel hose supplied ready to fit
Rail Fittings: 8AN ORB to 6AN male fitting for the rail end port, plus an 8AN ORB plug for the unused port
Quick Install: Radium quotes under 10 minutes when used with the Radium 20-0753 port injection kit
Fuel Compatibility: Suitable for all fuel types, including E85
SAE quick connect tee PTFE hose assembly
ft: Radium Engineering Port Injection Fuel Rail Plumbing Kit for Toyota Supra A90 2019+/BMW Z4 G29 2018+
